title: Binance Copy Trading Will Apply New ROI Method to All Spot Lead Portfolios
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Copy Trading will update the  ROI calculation method which will apply to all existing active Spot lead portfolios,  effective from  2026-05-08 03:00 (UTC) .  The new ROI calculation method introduces a new concept of  “Maxbasebalance” to replace  accumulated deposits, providing a more accurate reflection of a trader’s performance. For more information on the new ROI calculation, please refer to “ Portfolio Performance Indicators in Binance Spot Copy Trading ”. About Binance Spot Copy Trading Spot copy trading allows you to copy experienced traders’ portfolios in real-time. After determining your investment amount, the system will automatically copy trades from the lead traders you follow.
